description:
Responsible for extracting, analyzing data and creating reports

 Experience with developing reports with SQL from a variety of databases (like Oracle). SQL Pathfinder experience, especially in generating dashboards or 1-Click solutions. Able to extract data to create reports, analyze the data in the reports to highlight areas for improvement focus. 
 Experience with understanding users reporting needs and translating those into actionable information with sustainable code. 
 Experience in a manufacturing environment 
 
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES. 

 3 months to start, but expecting extensions. Assignments are extended on a quarterly basis with this group
